text:
mike.sales: Passing Pelago Systems to CS — kickoff targeted next Tue 10am PT. Quick context: they committed 12 seats, plan to evaluate a private deployment (VPC) and SSO via Okta, and have a data-classification requirement (PII filtering). Renewal in ~11 months. Sales notes: high ingest during initial batch import, asked about dedicated capacity options and costs. Primary contacts: emma@pelago.com (PM) and raj@pelago.com (infra). Posting the short sales summary + contact info below.

mike.sales: Config snippet sales pasted:
```
customer: Pelago Systems
contacts:
  - emma@pelago.com (PM)
  - raj@pelago.com (Infra lead)
auth: Okta SSO (OIDC)
network: VPC peering or private link, allowed IPs TBD
needs: private-deploy-eval, model whitelist for PII redaction, throughput target 600 qps for batch ingestion window
commit: 12 seats, potential Dedicated eval
renewal: 11 months
```

amanda.csm: Thanks — I'll own onboarding. :wave: I'll schedule the kickoff and the enablement session. Can @mike.sales drop the Okta metadata and any firewall/IP ranges we have from their side? Also, can we confirm whether they need encryption-at-rest with customer-managed keys?

mike.sales: Okta metadata attached in email but here's the IdP issuer and callback for now: issuer=https://pelago.okta.com/oauth2/default, callback=https://console.redwood.ai/auth/okta/callback. Raj said infra will provide IP ranges by EOD. They asked about CMK — probable yes, they're regulated.

jordan.support: I can handle the VPC/network setup + runbook for peering. Need Raj's ASN and CIDRs. Also heads-up: we should validate our model whitelist process before the eval — need eng to confirm whitelisting for custom models. @devon.eng FYI. :eyes:

devon.eng: Acknowledged. I can validate whitelist flow and check the PII-redaction hooks. If you can paste a sanitized sample payload we can run through the eval flow. What do they mean by "model whitelist" — are they expecting only a small subset of models allowed, or custom internal models?

mike.sales: They want to lock to our curated open models plus a custom fine-tuned for semantic matching (will be uploaded later). So initial whitelist = {redwood-2-small, redwood-2-medium}. Fine-tuned model comes after contract. Sample payload: `{ "user_text": "Patient name: John Doe, diagnosis: asthma" }` (will sanitize in transit).

amanda.csm: Great. Next steps I'm proposing:
- Amanda (CS): schedule kickoff + invite Pelago & Sales (mike) + Support (jordan) + Eng (devon) — target Tue 10am PT
- Jordan (Support): draft VPC peering checklist and required Pelago CIDRs by EOD tomorrow
- Devon (Eng): run whitelist validation and test PII-redaction hook with sanitized sample by Thu EOD
- Mike (Sales): confirm Okta metadata and CMK requirement in thread when Raj confirms
- Amanda: create enablement doc and share playbook for private-eval (access + steps + rollback)

amanda.csm: I'll also capture renewal note: potential upsell for Dedicated if throughput during eval looks good — mark as opportunity in account plan. Renewal in 11 months, flag finance for potential mid-term quoting.

mike.sales: Noted. One risk: they warned about strict SLA expectations for incident response. If we need a higher SLA during the eval, sales may have to escalate to an enterprise support add-on.

jordan.support: Copy. I'll include an escalation path and temporary monitoring hooks (webhooks + token-level metrics) in the runbook. Also will provision a short-lived api-key for their import window and rotate after testing.

devon.eng: For the whitelist and PII flow I'll need an example of the fine-tune artifact format when they upload, plus any policy rules they want enforced (e.g., redact names, DOB). If they require HSM-backed CMK ops, that's a separate infra ticket — ping @amanda.csm to confirm and I'll open an ENG-OPS ticket if needed.

amanda.csm: I'll confirm CMK need with Raj in kickoff and post here. Also capturing asks for enablement session: 1) SSO setup 2) network peering 3) model whitelist + upload flow 4) monitoring and SLAs 5) billing/seat configuration.

mike.sales: Raj replied via email: CIDRs `10.10.0.0/16` and `172.20.0.0/24`. He also confirmed CMK required. He can join Tue kickoff.

jordan.support: Thanks — that CIDR set looks good for peering. I'll start the peering pre-checks.

amanda.csm: I'll send the calendar invite now: Tue 10am PT — invite includes meeting agenda + list of owners. I'll post the invite link and the enablement doc after I create it. :calendar:

deploy-bot: Runbook created: /docs/onboarding/pelago/preflight-checklist (private link)

amanda.csm: Closing checklist for initial handoff: owners assigned, kickoff scheduled, eng validation task created. If anything else pops up before kickoff @mike.sales please post here.

mike.sales: Thanks all — leaving this in your hands. Cheers. :slightly_smiling_face:
